messages.subject: spam outbreak
parts:
Hi folks, 
Clearly we are having another spam outbreak on this list. I am banning the senders and trying to train google group's spam filters. Last time this happened, it seemed that the problems went away before long. Please train your spam filters (but hopefully not for all nimble-users messages!) and be patient with this. 
Thanks
Perry
